text: The conflict is harder than 'guidance': RepetitionValidator flags any 5-gram repeated across pages (maximumRepeatedNGrams defaults to 0), and validate_beat_corpus.py fails the corpus on shared 5-grams (check_collisions) and reused rhetorical moves (check_moves). A refrain is by definition a repeated n-gram, so every refrain story would be flagged. Feasible path: a declared refrain slot on the blueprint (one line, fixed pages, one changed final use) that both validators whitelist explicitly, so accidental repetition stays a defect. This is the most promising proposal for read-aloud at 3-6, but 3/5 books does not justify loosening a gate globally.
